headline: T-Mobile retires legacy plans with $4 avg price hike
summary: T-Mobile is retiring old plans, moving customers to modern plans with a 5-year price guarantee. The change affects billing cycles starting mid-July.
details: T-Mobile is retiring its oldest plans, some of which were built nearly 15 years ago. The company will transition customers to modern plans with access to 5G technology and enhanced features.

The average adjustment for customers will be $4 per line, and changes will appear in the next billing cycle starting mid-July. Some customers will see no change to their monthly bill, while others will see a modest adjustment.

Customers on the new plans will retain their current benefits and gain improvements in network and service experiences, including enhanced device offers, streaming services, and improved international roaming and travel perks.

headline_marked: Google adds [[personalized intelligence to Gemini app]] image creation
headline: Google adds personalized intelligence to Gemini app image creation
summary: Gemini app now uses personal data for image requests in the US
details: Google is expanding its personalized intelligence feature to the Gemini app's image creation capabilities. This allows users to generate images based on their personal data across Google services.
The feature is rolling out to all eligible users in the US with personal accounts. It was previously available only to subscribers of AI Pro and AI Ultra plans.
Users over 18 can access the feature, which supports 11 languages, including English, Spanish, French, and German.
caption:
Can Gemini now create images of you and your loved ones?

Google is expanding its personalized intelligence feature to the Gemini app's image creation capabilities. This allows users to generate images based on their personal data across Google services.

The feature is rolling out to all eligible users in the US with personal accounts. It was previously available only to subscribers of AI Pro and AI Ultra plans.

Users over 18 can access the feature, which supports 11 languages, including English, Spanish, French, and German.
